|quote=Eleven years have passed since former Mexican president Felipe Calderón declared war on drug cartels in early December 2006, deploying the army in the country's most troubled areas. Fuelled by growing US demand for drugs, particularly opioids, Mexican cartels are more powerful than ever. ''“Mexican criminal organisations show continuing signs of growth and expansion,”'' notes the annual report published in late October by the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), the US anti-drug agency. It adds: ''“No other group is in a position to compete with them.”''
